worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.summary: Climbs high, then dives straight down at the target: foes struck on the way take contact damage, and the landing shockwave settles the primary target, shoves anyone it catches away from the impact point and cracks the ground. The moment it launches the user's Defense and Sp. Def each drop one stage; the broad form reaches wider, catches nearby foes and shoves harder, at the cost of lower dive power.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.use.0: Ascend and drop straight onto a target
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.use.1: Finish with a landing shockwave that shoves what it catches
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.use.2: Fall past the front line onto a target behind it
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.descripti: After climbing it dives straight down at the target; a foe struck on the way takes about %1$s physical contact damage, and landing rings out a %2$s-block shockwave.
Engages within %1$s blocks, climbs %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks/tick, with a %4$s-block dive radius.
It drops its guard the moment it launches: the user's Defense drops %1$s stage(s) and Sp. Def drops %2$s, hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.broad.on: Broad form: other foes caught by the shockwave take about %1$s of the primary target's damage and are thrown %2$s blocks away from the impact point.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.broad.off: Plunging form: all force on the landing target, heavier on a single target and a faster cast; the landing shockwave only affects the primary target and catches no one else.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.growth.0: From level %1$s the dive power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.growth.1: From level %1$s the dive power rises to %2$s and the climb to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.preferenc: On: landing radius x1.3, shockwave push x1.2 and other foes around the landing point take a share of the power; costs dive power x0.88, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off (plunging): heavier single target, faster cast, tighter shock.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first; larger ascends from farther out.
Only at least this far away will it prefer this move; some horizontal room helps the climb-and-drop. Within 1.5 blocks it scores lower so closer options take over.
On: low-health targets rank higher so this finishes them from the sky; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Dragon Ascent back (0 = no limit). Higher saves it for a worthwhile trade.
worldcombat.skill.dragonascent.descripti: The landing shockwave settles the primary target: if the dive did not strike it, the shockwave deals the full damage instead, and anyone it catches is shoved away from the impact point.
The impact point is left as cracked stone, restoring the ground after about 7 seconds.
